WPFTweaksRemoveEdge.Reason: Uninstalls Microsoft Edge through an unsupported workaround. Parts of Windows and other programs expect Edge to be present.

WPFTweaksRazerBlock.Reason: Sets DisableCoInstallers and turns driver searching off, which blocks the vendor helper programs that run during driver installation. This can break drivers for USB and diagnostic interfaces.

WPFTweaksDiskCleanup.Reason: Runs DISM /StartComponentCleanup /ResetBase, which cannot be undone. Installed Windows updates can no longer be uninstalled afterwards.

WPFUpdatesdisable.Reason: Turns Windows Update off completely, so the machine stops receiving security updates.
